author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Great philosophy Jacquelinne, "My philosophy is to be flexible with students and their needs and to start them off with a foundation that will help them grow and have a willingness to learn and not resentment...understand that each student is unique in their backgrounds and that we should create a classroom environment that exemplifies that rather than subdue it." #edu407
